signal: Xola rolled out XolaBot, its AI-driven marketing automation suite handling cart recovery, upsells, and revenue optimization for tour and activity operators, with expanded distribution across Viator and GetYourGuide.

email.body1:
Daniel, saw Xola roll out XolaBot for cart recovery and upsells as you expand distribution across Viator and GetYourGuide.

When the product moves into AI like that, the list of operators worth a conversation grows faster than the team can personally work, and good accounts slip before a rep follows up. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Xola off your product and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Daniel, quick follow-up for Xola.

As XolaBot widens the story, more operators are in-market than the team can touch, and most sales orgs do not know how many meetings they actually need to book to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Xola needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Daniel, last bit of proof for Xola.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Xola's reply rate likely compares to other SaaS startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Daniel, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out an AI product is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Xola either way.
